value: Canada Energy Regulator (2026). Renewable Energy in Canada - An Overview of Bioenergy. Web page, date modified 2026-03-25. https://www.cer-rec.gc.ca/en/data-analysis/energy-markets/renewable-energy-canada/an-overview-of-bioenergy.html

NO TECHNOLOGY PARAMETERS. A statistical overview of bioenergy supply and use in Canada. Its industrial-use figures (solid biofuels and biogas for industrial heat and cogeneration) are calibration data for the demand side, kept in _sector-intensity with the page's section names as locators. The underlying XLSX data files linked from the page were not downloaded.
